item.title: German retail sales drop 0.9% in January, exceeding forecasts
item.description: German retail sales declined 0.9% in January compared to December, according to data released Monday. The drop exceeded analyst expectations, as economists polled by Reuters had forecast a decrease of 0.2%. The steeper-than-anticipated decline in retail sales points to weaker consumer spending in Europe’s largest economy at the start of the year. Source: Investing.com
